out4=[[1]*18 for _ in range(18)]
# fixed cut-line 7: horizontal row9, vertical c9 only above intersection
for r in range(18):
 for c in range(18):
  if G[r][c]==7 and (r==9 or (c==9 and r<9)):out4[r][c]=7
# upper quadrants
for cond,er,ec in [(lambda r,c:r<9 and c<9,0,0),(lambda r,c:r<9 and c>9,0,17)]:
 pts=[(r,c) for r in range(18) for c in range(18) if G[r][c]==7 and cond(r,c)]
 if pts:
  dr=-min(r for r,c in pts); dc=-min(c for r,c in pts) if ec==0 else 17-max(c for r,c in pts)
  for r,c in pts:out4[r+dr][c+dc]=7
# lower entire region no vertical split
pts=[(r,c) for r in range(18) for c in range(18) if G[r][c]==7 and r>9]
dr=17-max(r for r,c in pts);dc=17-max(c for r,c in pts)
for r,c in pts:out4[r+dr][c+dc]=7
# 2 line painting
for r in range(9):
 if out4[r][9]!=7:out4[r][9]=2
for c in range(8,18):
 if out4[9][c]!=7:out4[9][c]=2
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,x)) for x in out4))
